name: lukka-pricing
description: Digital asset prices, candles, VWAP and order books. Requires an entitled Lukka account.

interface.longDescription: Lukka Pricing & Market Data MCP. Read digital asset spot and index prices, historical observations, OHLCV candles, VWAP, market capitalization, order books, and spot and derivative trades from Lukka. Compare observed prices and liquidity across available sources. A connected Lukka account with Pricing API entitlement is required. Coverage and timestamps depend on the source, instrument and account. Provides data for research; does not execute trades, transfers or recurring alerts. Source availability must be discovered before choosing venue-specific requests.
defaultPrompt: Show the latest available Bitcoin and Ether USD prices with timestamps.
Compare Bitcoin USD VWAP over the last hour.

prompts: Show the latest available USD prices for Bitcoin and Ether, with their sources and timestamps.
Show up to 24 hourly Bitcoin USD candles from an available exchange for the last day.
Show up to seven daily Bitcoin USD price observations for the last week.
Show the five largest digital assets by the latest market capitalization available to my account.
Compare Bitcoin USD VWAP across available exchanges during the last hour.

positive.description: Latest prices for two canonical pairs.
positive.prompt: Show the latest available USD prices for Bitcoin and Ether, with their sources and timestamps.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover an entitled price source; request pairCodes XBT-USD,ETH-USD with its sourceId. Identify observed price basis and timestamps. Report missing coverage without inventing prices.

positive.prompt: Show up to 24 hourly Bitcoin USD candles from an available exchange for the last day.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover a candles source for XBT-USD; use interval 3600000, limit 24 and an explicit UTC window. Report OHLCV values and the actual venue. Do not substitute an index source.

positive.prompt: Show up to seven daily Bitcoin USD price observations for the last week.
positive.expected_behavior: Use XBT-USD, an entitled price source, interval 86400000, limit 7 and explicit from/to. Preserve dates and explain gaps or unavailable history.

positive.prompt: Show the five largest digital assets by the latest market capitalization available to my account.
positive.expected_behavior: Request limit 5 and descending market-cap ordering using the live schema. Report returned ranking, units and timestamps; do not confuse price rank with market-cap rank.

positive.description: Cross-source VWAP with a bounded window.
positive.prompt: Compare Bitcoin USD VWAP across available exchanges during the last hour.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover entitled VWAP sources, use XBT-USD and a UTC window no longer than one hour. Pass sourceIds when available; report observed VWAP, venue and missing coverage without claiming execution prices.

negative.description: Explain that order execution and standing orders are unsupported. Do not invoke market-data tools as if they placed an order.
negative.prompt: Create a standing order to buy Bitcoin whenever its price falls below my target.

negative.description: Explain that recurring monitoring and email delivery are not provided by this server; do not claim an alert was created.
negative.prompt: Enable a background alert that emails me every morning with these prices.

negative.description: Distinguish observed data from forecasts; do not claim a guaranteed future price or invent a forecast.
negative.prompt: Tell me exactly what Bitcoin's price will be next month and guarantee it.

publication.release_notes: Removes MCP from public product names to follow OpenAI naming guidelines. Retains the product-specific skills, Lukka website and existing MCP configuration.
